relationships.subject: Anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: significant decreases in photophobia (-19.5%, p < 0.001), phonophobia (-12.1%, p = 0.010) and aura ratios (-25.1%, p = 0.008) were found in ≥50% response rate group

relationships.subject: Anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: A significant reduction in headache days per month in both groups was found at month 6

key_findings: Photophobia, phonophobia and aura fell faster than headache days in responders to anti-CGRP mAbs.
Higher baseline photophobia predicted greater response.
